description: This file defines a Flutter widget named NotesSidebar that displays a list of annotations/notes for the current chapter. It includes functionality for viewing, editing, and deleting notes, with UI components for interaction and editing annotations. The code interacts with application state via provider classes BookState and AnnotationState, and it references Annotation models.

classes.name: NotesSidebar
classes.description: A stateless widget that presents a sidebar displaying annotations for the current chapter. It handles rendering notes, editing/deleting annotations, and UI for user interactions.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the NotesSidebar, showing a list of annotations or a placeholder message if none exist.

methods.name: _showEditSheet
methods.description: Displays a modal bottom sheet allowing the user to edit an annotation's note text and color.
